The model name.

version.description:
Gets or sets the version identifier of the model.
The version string, or null if not versioned.

isActive.description:
Gets or sets whether the model is currently active.
True if the model is active; otherwise, false.

SeriesSimpleModelDto.description: Simplified model information for display within a series context.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the health snapshot was generated (UTC).

overallStatus.description: Overall health status across all services (healthy, degraded, or unhealthy).

summary.description: Summary counts of services by health status.

services.description: Health details for each monitored service.

ServiceHealthResponse.description: Response containing current health status for all monitored services.

unknown.description: Number of services whose status could not be determined.

ServiceHealthSummary.description: Summary counts of services by health status.

ServiceInstanceStatusDto.description: Health and build identity for one application service instance.

status.description: Health status of the service (healthy, degraded, or unhealthy).

version.description:
Logical service version, `mixed` when active instances do not match, or null
for dependencies that do not expose an application version.

instances.description: Per-instance status for clustered application services.

uptime.description:
How long the service has been running, or `null` when it is not known
(e.g. a service reporting via heartbeat that has not been seen yet).

lastCheck.description: Timestamp of the last health check (UTC).

responseTime.description:
Health check response time in milliseconds, or `null` when a response time is
not applicable (e.g. liveness derived from a heartbeat rather than a probe).

details.description: Service-specific detail values (shape varies per service).

ServiceStatusDto.description: Health status for a single monitored service.

id.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier of the series.

name.description: Gets or sets the name of the model series.

description.description: Gets or sets the description of the series.

tokenizerType.description: Gets or sets the tokenizer type used by this series.

modelCount.description: Gets or sets the number of models in this series.

SimpleModelSeriesDto.description: Simplified model series information for display within an author context.

retentionDays.description: Current retention days setting (null if using policy-based).

isOverrideActive.description: Whether the simple override is currently active.

SimpleRetentionResponse.description: Response for simple retention override operations.

workingSetMb.description: Process working set size in megabytes.

gcMemoryMb.description: Total memory tracked by the garbage collector in megabytes.

threadCount.description: Number of threads in the current process.

uptime.description: Time elapsed since the process started.

SystemMetricsDto.description: Host system metrics for the current process.

cleaned_up.description: Number of tasks that were cleaned up.

older_than_hours.description: The age threshold, in hours, used for the cleanup.

TaskCleanupResponseDto.description: Response returned when old asynchronous tasks are cleaned up.

TimeRangeDto.description: Time range covered by a monitoring response.

value.description: Numeric value of the provider type

description.description: Description of the provider's tool support

ToolProviderDto.description: DTO describing a provider type that supports tools

secretSettings.description:
Secret-valued structured settings. Object members merge recursively; null removes the
entire settings object or an individual member at that member's path.

enabled.description: Whether to enable or disable the media cleanup service.

UpdateMediaCleanupEnabledRequest.description: Request to update the media cleanup enabled state.

UpdateMediaRetentionPolicyRequest.description: Request model for updating an existing media retention policy.

name.description: Gets or sets the ID of the author to update.

websiteUrl.description: Gets or sets the new website URL.

description.description: Gets or sets the new description.

UpdateModelAuthorDto.description: Data transfer object for updating an existing model author/organization.

name.description:
Gets or sets the ID of the model to update.
The unique identifier of the model to update.

modelSeriesId.description:
Gets or sets the new model series ID.
The new series ID.

inputModalities.description: Replaces the model's accepted modalities when provided.

outputModalities.description: Replaces the model's output modalities when provided.

oneOf.description: Updates the provenance for directional capability metadata.

capabilitiesLastVerifiedAt.description: Updates when the directional capability metadata was verified.

clearDirectionalCapabilities.description:
Clears directional metadata and marks it unknown. This is distinct from
supplying empty arrays, which explicitly means no modalities are supported.

supportsChat.description:
Gets or sets whether the model supports chat/conversation interactions.
True to enable chat support or false to disable it.

supportsVision.description:
Gets or sets whether the model supports vision/image understanding.
True to enable vision support or false to disable it.

supportsFunctionCalling.description:
Gets or sets whether the model supports function/tool calling.
True to enable function calling or false to disable it.

supportsStreaming.description:
Gets or sets whether the model supports streaming responses.
True to enable streaming or false to disable it.

supportsImageGeneration.description:
Gets or sets whether the model supports image generation.
True to enable image generation or false to disable it.

supportsVideoGeneration.description:
Gets or sets whether the model supports video generation.
True to enable video generation or false to disable it.

supportsSpeechToText.description: Whether the model supports speech-to-text transcription.

supportsTextToSpeech.description: Whether the model supports text-to-speech synthesis.

supportsRerank.description: Whether the model supports document reranking.

supportsEmbeddings.description:
Gets or sets whether the model supports text embeddings generation.
True to enable embeddings or false to disable it.

maxInputTokens.description:
Gets or sets the maximum number of input tokens the model can process.
The new max input tokens, or null to clear the override.

maxOutputTokens.description:
Gets or sets the maximum number of output tokens the model can generate.
The new max output tokens, or null to clear the override.

isActive.description:
Gets or sets the new activation status for the model.
True to activate or false to deactivate.

modelParameters.description:
Gets or sets the model-specific parameter configuration for UI generation.
JSON string containing parameter definitions, or null to use series defaults.

UpdateModelDto.description: Data transfer object for updating an existing AI model in the system.

description.description:
Gets or sets the new description for the series.
The new description, or null to clear it.

oneOf.description:
Gets or sets the new tokenizer type for the series.
The new tokenizer type.

parameters.description:
Gets or sets the new UI parameters configuration.
The parameter object to merge, or null to clear it.

UpdateModelSeriesDto.description: Data transfer object for updating an existing model series.

UpdateSimpleRetentionRequest.description: Request to set or clear the simple retention override.

pricingConfiguration.description: The pricing configuration JSON to validate

parameterSchema.description:
Optional parameter schema JSON for standalone validation. The model-cost-scoped
endpoint ignores this value and uses persisted associated-model schemas.

ValidatePricingRulesRequest.description: Request model for validating pricing rules

VirtualKeyGroupSummaryDto.description: Summary information for a virtual key group.

lastUsed.description: Last time this key was used

modelsUsed.description: List of model names used with this key, or null when the aggregation does not provide it
